channel.title: Antigravity Tools — 52 Free Browser Dev Tools
channel.description: 52 free browser-based developer tools. Zero installs, 100% client-side privacy.

item.title: Mobile Speaker Water & Dust Cleaner
item.description: Play 165 Hz sound-wave pulses directly in your browser to push water droplets and dust out of your phone speaker — free, instant, no app needed.

item.title: Stolen Mobile Emergency Assistant & CEIR Guide
item.description: Step-by-step wizard for lost or stolen phones: remotely lock your device, block the IMEI via CEIR, suspend your SIM with your carrier, and generate an e-FIR report.

item.title: IMEI Luhn Validator & TAC Decoder
item.description: Instantly verify any 15-digit IMEI number using the Luhn checksum algorithm, decode the TAC manufacturer code, and extract the device serial number — 100% client-side.

item.title: Emergency Lock Screen Wallpaper Generator
item.description: Create a custom mobile lock screen wallpaper with your emergency contact numbers, blood group, medical conditions, and allergies — generated entirely in your browser.

item.title: Mobile Display & Dead Pixel Tester
item.description: Run a full-screen RGBW and black color cycle test to detect dead pixels, stuck pixels, and OLED burn-in on your phone, tablet, or laptop — free, instant, browser-based.

item.title: Multi-Touch & Screen Refresh Rate (Hz) Tester
item.description: Measure your phone or laptop screen's real refresh rate (60Hz, 90Hz, 120Hz, 144Hz) and test simultaneous multi-touch points — all live in your browser, no app required.

item.title: Mobile Wi-Fi, eSIM & WhatsApp QR Suite
item.description: Generate Wi-Fi auto-connect QR codes, WhatsApp chat links, eSIM QR, and vCard contact QR codes — all in your browser, no app, no signup.

item.title: YouTube HD & 4K Thumbnail Downloader
item.description: Download any YouTube video thumbnail in 4K, 1080p, 720p, or SD quality by pasting the video URL — instant, free, no login required.

item.title: YouTube Timestamp & Chapter Generator
item.description: Build shareable YouTube timestamp links and format clickable chapter descriptions in seconds — just enter the times and titles, copy the output.

item.title: YouTube Transcript & Subtitle Cleaner
item.description: Paste raw YouTube auto-generated captions and instantly strip all timestamps, speaker labels, and formatting — ready to paste into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini for AI summaries.

item.title: YouTube Video Tag & Keyword Inspector
item.description: Reveal the hidden tags, SEO keywords, title, description, and channel metadata of any YouTube video — essential for YouTube SEO research and competitor analysis.

item.title: YouTube Channel Banner Safe Zone Visualizer
item.description: Visualize the exact YouTube channel banner safe zone overlay for TV, desktop, tablet, and mobile — upload your design and see what gets cropped before you publish.

item.title: Clean YouTube Responsive Iframe Generator
item.description: Generate clean, responsive YouTube iframe embed code with custom start time, autoplay, loop, controls, and privacy-enhanced mode — copy and paste into any website.

item.title: AI Token & Cost Estimator
item.description: Count tokens and estimate API cost across GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0, DeepSeek R1, and Llama 3 — paste your prompt and get instant results, 100% client-side.

item.title: System Prompt & Agent Skill Builder
item.description: Structure professional AI system prompts with custom instructions, tool definitions, XML tags, role definitions, constraints, and output formats for ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini agents.

item.title: LLM JSON Schema Builder
item.description: Paste any JSON sample and instantly generate a valid JSON Schema definition for OpenAI function calling, Gemini structured outputs, and Pydantic models.

item.title: AI Text Humanizer & Paraphraser
item.description: Rephrase robotic AI-generated text into natural, fluent human writing with custom tone options — friendly, professional, casual, or academic. Bypass AI detectors.

item.title: AI Prompt Cost Trimmer
item.description: Compress long LLM prompts by 30–50% by removing stop words, redundant phrases, and filler — preserving core context while slashing your OpenAI or Claude API bill.

item.title: AI Code Bug & Security Scanner
item.description: Paste any code snippet and get an instant analysis of performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities (XSS, SQL injection, hardcoded secrets), and edge-case bugs — free, no signup.

item.title: AI Speech & Audio Transcriber
item.description: Transcribe speech and audio recordings into clean text using your browser's built-in Speech Recognition API — no upload, no API key, works directly in Chrome, Edge, and Safari.

item.title: AI Background Remover
item.description: Remove the background from any photo or product image directly in your browser using canvas color detection — no signup, no upload, 100% private.

item.title: Website Trust Badge Builder
item.description: Design and export custom embeddable SVG or HTML trust verification badges for your SaaS, e-commerce site, or landing page — free, no watermark, instant download.

item.title: Social Open Graph (OG) Previewer
item.description: Preview exactly how your website's Open Graph meta tags will render as link cards on Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, Discord, and Telegram before publishing.

item.title: Meta Tag & SEO Head Builder
item.description: Generate a complete, SEO-optimized HTML <head> section with title, meta description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, robots, and viewport tags — copy and paste ready.

item.title: Favicon & App Icon Generator
item.description: Upload any image or type any emoji to instantly generate favicons in all required sizes (16×16, 32×32, 180×180, 192×192, 512×512) with the correct HTML head snippet.

item.title: Schema.org Rich Snippet Builder
item.description: Build valid Schema.org JSON-LD structured data for FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization, BreadcrumbList, and LocalBusiness — copy and add to your site for Google Rich Snippets.

item.title: Core Web Vitals Audit Simulator
item.description: Simulate and understand your Core Web Vitals scores — Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), and First Input Delay (FID) — with optimization tips.

item.title: Visual XML Sitemap & Robots Builder
item.description: Generate a valid XML sitemap and robots.txt file for any website by entering your URLs — with changefreq, priority, and lastmod settings. Download and submit to Google Search Console.

item.title: GDPR Privacy Policy Generator
item.description: Generate a complete, customized GDPR and CCPA compliant privacy policy document for your website or app in minutes — just fill in your details and copy the HTML.

item.title: Redirect & HTTP Status Tester
item.description: Test any URL's HTTP status code, follow redirect chains (301, 302, 307, 308), and verify your HTTPS/www redirects are working correctly — free, instant, no signup.

item.title: JSON Workbench & Type Converter
item.description: Beautify, minify, and validate JSON in your browser. Convert JSON to TypeScript interfaces, Python dataclasses, Go structs, and SQL table schemas — instantly, no server.

item.title: cURL to Code Converter
item.description: Paste any cURL terminal command and instantly convert it to JavaScript fetch(), Python requests, Go http, or PHP cURL code — ready to paste into your project.

item.title: SVG Optimizer & React Builder
item.description: Paste SVG code to remove redundant attributes, clean metadata, optimize paths, and convert to a React JSX component with proper props — all in the browser.

item.title: SQL Formatter & Query Beautifier
item.description: Paste messy SQL queries and format them into clean, readable code with proper indentation, keyword capitalization, and dialect support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.

item.title: Regex Tester & Visualizer
item.description: Test regular expressions with real-time match highlighting, group capture display, substitution preview, and common regex pattern library — free, instant, browser-based.

item.title: Cron Schedule Builder & Explainer
item.description: Build cron job expressions visually with sliders and dropdowns, get a human-readable description of any cron expression, and see the next 5 scheduled run times.

item.title: Git CLI Command Helper
item.description: Construct complex Git commands visually — undo commits, squash, cherry-pick, rebase, stash, and more — with explanations of what each command does before you run it.

item.title: JWT Inspector & Payload Debugger
item.description: Paste any JSON Web Token to instantly decode its header, payload claims, and check expiration time — 100% client-side, your token is never sent to any server.

item.title: Universal Encoder / Decoder
item.description: Encode and decode text in Base64, URL encoding, HTML entities, Hex, Binary, and Unicode — all in one multi-tab tool, 100% client-side.

item.title: Hash & Password Generator
item.description: Generate SHA-256 and SHA-512 cryptographic hashes using the browser Web Crypto API, and create strong random passwords with custom length and character rules — 100% client-side.

item.title: UUID & ULID Generator
item.description: Generate cryptographically secure UUID v4 and ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier) identifiers in bulk — copy as JSON array, CSV, or plain list.

item.title: Subnet & IP CIDR Calculator
item.description: Calculate IPv4 subnet masks, network addresses, usable IP ranges, broadcast addresses, and number of hosts for any CIDR notation — free, instant, browser-based.

item.title: CORS & Security Header Inspector
item.description: Analyze CORS policies and HTTP security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.) for any URL — identify misconfigurations, missing headers, and security risks.

item.title: Data PII Redactor & Masker
item.description: Automatically detect and mask Personally Identifiable Information (emails, phone numbers, credit cards, SSNs, IP addresses) from any text — 100% client-side, data stays private.

item.title: RSA & ECC Cryptographic Key Generator
item.description: Generate RSA 2048/4096-bit and ECC P-256/P-384 public/private PEM key pairs directly in your browser using the Web Crypto API — no server, keys never leave your device.

item.title: Markdown Live Editor & Preview
item.description: Write Markdown with a real-time side-by-side HTML preview. Supports GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM), tables, code blocks, and task lists — export as HTML or copy rendered output.

item.title: Diff Checker & Code Comparison
item.description: Compare two blocks of text or code side-by-side with visual line-by-line diff highlighting — additions in green, deletions in red. Free, instant, browser-based.

item.title: Text Case & Slug Converter
item.description: Convert text between camelCase, kebab-case, snake_case, PascalCase, UPPER_CASE, Title Case, and URL slugs — instantly, with one click per conversion.

item.title: WebP Image Converter & Compressor
item.description: Compress and convert PNG and JPG images to WebP format locally in your browser — reduce file size by up to 80% without uploading to any server.

item.title: PDF Merger & Splitter Studio
item.description: Merge multiple PDF files or extract specific pages from a PDF directly in your browser — no upload, no server, no registration. Private and instant.

item.title: Audio Trimmer & Volume Booster
item.description: Trim audio recordings, boost volume, and export as MP3 or WAV directly in your browser — no upload, no server, works on MP3, WAV, M4A, and OGG files.

item.title: Video to GIF Converter & Frame Extractor
item.description: Convert MP4 and WebM video clips to animated GIF or extract individual frames directly in your browser — no upload, no watermark, free and instant.

item.title: CSS Glassmorphism & Shadow Studio
item.description: Design stunning glassmorphism CSS effects with visual sliders for backdrop blur, transparency, border, and neon glow — copy the CSS instantly. Free, browser-based.

item.title: CSS Flexbox & Grid Builder
item.description: Build and visualize CSS Flexbox layouts interactively — change justify-content, align-items, flex-direction, gap, and wrap settings with live preview and instant CSS output.

item.title: WCAG Color Contrast Checker
item.description: Check text and background color combinations against WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA accessibility standards — get the contrast ratio, pass/fail result, and suggested fixes instantly.

item.title: Brand Palette Extractor from Image
item.description: Upload any logo, photo, or screenshot to automatically extract a 5-color aesthetic brand palette with hex codes — great for brand guidelines, UI design, and presentations.

item.title: CSS Keyframe Motion Animator
item.description: Build custom CSS @keyframes animations with a visual builder — set motion, easing, duration, and delay with live preview. Copy production-ready CSS instantly.

item.title: Tailwind CSS to Pure CSS Converter
item.description: Paste Tailwind CSS utility classes and instantly convert them to equivalent pure CSS declarations — perfect for migrating away from Tailwind or understanding what each class does.

item.title: Social Banner & Thumbnail Resizer
item.description: Resize and crop images to the exact pixel dimensions required for Twitter/X headers, YouTube thumbnails, LinkedIn banners, Instagram posts, and Facebook covers — free, instant.
